q: Do we have to be in Lovejoy ISD?
a: No! "Lovejoy" is just our name — we have families from Lovejoy, Allen, and McKinney schools, and every school district is welcome. Private school and homeschool families are welcome too.
Yes! Cub Scouts has been fully co-ed since 2018—many of our dens have girls, and siblings often join together.

q: My child is neurodivergent or has a hard time in group settings — is Scouting a fit?
a: Yes — every kid is welcome here, full stop. Dens are small, a parent is always right there, and everything is hands-on and go-at-your-own-pace, which works well for a lot of kids who find school-style settings tough. If there's anything that would help your scout have a great time, just mention it to your den leader. Best way to find out is to come try a meeting.
Lion (K), Tiger (1st), Wolf (2nd), Bear (3rd), Webelos (4th), Arrow of Light (5th). Kids are always with their own grade.
Absolutely—scouts join year-round. Registration fees are prorated by BSA, and we'll get your scout caught up with their den.
Life happens—there's no attendance requirement. Come when you can; advancement can be worked on at home too.
